Admin routes of the webhooks module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/webhooks

List webhook subscriptions

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## POST /v1/admin/webhooks

Create new webhook subscription

Request body: [CreateWebhookDto](#createwebhookdto).

Responses:

- `201`: no description.

## DELETE /v1/admin/webhooks/{id}

Delete webhook subscription

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: no description.

## GET /v1/admin/webhooks/{id}

Get webhook subscription

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## PATCH /v1/admin/webhooks/{id}

Update webhook subscription

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateWebhookDto](#updatewebhookdto).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## GET /v1/admin/webhooks/{id}/deliveries

List deliveries for a webhook subscription

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## POST /v1/admin/webhooks/{id}/test

Send a test event to a webhook subscription

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `201`: no description. Body: object.

- `secret` (string, optional).

### UpdateWebhookDto

- `isActive` (boolean, optional).
